assets.name: threshold-labyrinth
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production decorative artwork for the login and registration page of an elegant Chinese literary narrative RPG. Portrait 2:3. A strange impossible doorway formed from folded ivory paper and graphite carved plates: several nested asymmetrical arches twist into a precise spiral corridor, long thin brushed-silver engraving lines trace each fold, tiny botanical inlays and a narrow cobalt ribbon lead toward a quiet luminous opening. The arch is a conceptual page threshold, not a particular world, religion, building or game faction. Exceptionally intricate crisp hand-engraved linework, layered paper fibers, hard edges, believable overlapping shadow, sophisticated surreal architectural illustration with controlled cinematic light. Silver-grey, warm ivory, deep cold ink and restrained cobalt. Composition biased to the left and center, deep dark lower corners, leave the right quarter less busy because a separate HTML account form will stand beside it. No humans, faces, gods, text, letters, numbers, logo, crest, watermark or interface. Do not design a logo. Do not place actual forms or buttons into the image. Avoid generic glowing orb, purple-gold gradients, heavy green fog, stock fantasy castle, smeared detail. Make the impossible geometry visually intriguing on repeated inspection and useful as a crop behind a real web interface.

assets.name: resonant-clockwork
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a final decorative illustration for a small music control panel in a finely crafted narrative game. Wide landscape 3:2. An impossible acoustic mechanism made of midnight graphite paper, extraordinarily fine concentric silver grooves and layered ivory sound ribbons. A circular etched resonator sits on the LEFT HALF, with several thin nested orbital rings passing behind it and an elegant small mechanical tonearm-like line; right half is mostly deep indigo quiet space, available for live HTML track information. The resonator is an abstract visual motif, not a real playable instrument or a fictional inventory item. Distinct intricate wavy engraving lines, tiny leaflike silver details, dark paper fibers, delicate pearlescent reflections, controlled cool cinematic side light. No painted play icons, buttons, controls, waveform measurements, notes, words, letters, numbers, logo or watermark. Do not design or replace a logo. Palette restrained ivory/silver/graphite/cobalt, no green mist, purple/gold, neon, random glitter or blur. It should resemble a mysterious handcrafted archival listening apparatus and remain legible as a 400-pixel-wide UI crop. Leave sufficient breathing room around the small detailed center; prefer one memorable sculptural construction over scattered unrelated objects.

assets.name: time-spindle
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A final wide 3:2 decorative illustration for saved-game archives and reading preference controls in a literary narrative game. A peculiar impossible spindle of time constructed from thin graphite plates, stacked ivory paper leaves, engraved silver measuring arcs, nested elliptical rings and one subtle cobalt archival ribbon. The winding structure curves diagonally from lower left toward upper right, with an empty small opening at the center and very fine almost architectural tracery. This is an abstract visual metaphor for retained chapters and editable typography, not a clock with actual time, not a usable magic item and not an in-world geographic place. Absolutely no clock digits, text, letters, numbers, words, logos, UI, buttons or watermark. Cold side light exposes precise etched grooves, tiny branching silver linework, paper fibers, brushed metal edges and naturally cast shadows. Deep midnight indigo at the lower/right edges, silver and ivory highlights at the upper left. Keep the center-left calm enough to crop behind live HTML headings. Richly authored, unusual layered geometry, crisp and tactile, luxurious but restrained. Avoid generic glowing sphere, purple/gold theme, emerald fog, fake runes, soft mushy detail, random floating ornaments. Do not design a logo.

assets.name: last-page-bird
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Final wide 3:2 fine-art frontispiece for a narrative RPG life-ending summary. A single paper swallow formed from many delicately folded ivory pages is departing toward the upper right; its long trailing tail dissolves into a fan of very thin silver-engraved paper strips that curl back around a closed blank folio at the lower right. It should feel reflective, dignified and strange, equally suitable for peaceful retirement or a character's death, with no violent scene and no assumption about the player's moral judgment. The LEFT HALF is quiet dark indigo paper, with fine parallel etched currents to support live HTML chapter titles; right half contains the detailed bird and layered pages. Subtle cobalt thread weaves once through the pages, silver and pearlescent highlights, refined graphite shadows, sharply printed engraving lines and real-feeling paper texture. No human figure, no deity, no religion, no invented in-world companion, no text, symbols standing for text, digits, logo, watermark or UI. Do not design a logo. Avoid bright gold, purple haze, emerald gradients, magic orbs, confetti and sentimental stock photography. We will render the real summary and evaluation separately in code; the illustration is decorative only.
